summary: LDAP User Attribute Map maps first_name, last_name and email to LDAP attributes; LDAP User Search is [base, SCOPE_SUBTREE, filter], and several searches form an LDAPUnion where users found in more than one branch cannot log in. A User DN Template takes precedence.
questions: How do I search multiple LDAP OUs for users?
Why can't an LDAP user found in two OUs log in?
How do I map LDAP email and name attributes?

answer_card.title: LDAP user search and attribute map
answer_card.answer_md:
**LDAP User Attribute Map**
```json
{"first_name": "givenname", "last_name": "sn", "email": "mail"}
```
**LDAP User Search** (several = LDAPUnion)
```json
[
  ["ou=users,dc=example,dc=com", "SCOPE_SUBTREE", "uid=%(user)s"],
  ["ou=employees,dc=subdivision,dc=com", "SCOPE_SUBTREE", "uid=%(user)s"]
]
```
A user found in both branches can't log in. If *LDAP User DN Template* is set, it is used instead.
